title: IBM security advisory (AV26-967)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-967 Date: September 28, 2026 As of September 25, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: IBM Big Replicate LiveData Migrator Prior to or equal to 3.3 IBM App Connect Enterprise Prior to or equal to version 13.0.1.0 to 13.0.8.2 DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data Prior to or equal to 5.4.0.0 Analyst Workflow Prior to or equal to version 1.0.0 - 3.1.0 IBM QRadar Deployment Intelligence App Prior to or equal to version 1.0.0 - 3.0.19 IBM Rhapsody Systems Engineering Prior to or equal to version 1.6.0-1.8.0 IBM Concert Prior to or equal to version 1.0.0 to 3.0.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates. IBM Product Security Incident Response Article Link: IBM security advisory (AV26-967) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
